item.title: Rob O’Neill Rolls Into Daytona With Hi Seltzer
item.description: At Daytona this weekend, Rob O’Neill is trading the usual trackside beer for something that better fits the life he’s living now, showing up with hi Seltzer, a full schedule, and the same forward momentum that has kept him moving since the Teams. #THC #RobONeill #DaytonaBeach #Daytona500 #HiSeltzer #MSN #SOFREP

item.title: Growing US Vulnerability Under Trump: Chinese and Russian Perceptions
item.description: Washington is hemorrhaging power across the military, diplomatic, economic, informational, and reputational fronts, and from Beijing and Moscow the spectacle looks less like strategic competition than an opportunity handed to them by a White House they can exploit without firing a shot. #Trump #RobertBruceAdolph #OpEd #ForeignAffairs #AmericaToday #SteadyState

item.title: Navy SEAL Sniper Mindset Tips: Self-Talk
item.description: In my SEAL training I learned to develop positive habits that affect real change by identifying the negative self-talk I wanted to fix. #NavySEALS #Sniper #SEAltraining #BrandonWebb #MSN #SOFREP

item.title: Evening Brief: NATO Expectations Change, US Boards Sanctioned Tanker, SOCOM Sources Intel
item.description: Washington is shifting NATO toward grown-up burden sharing, chasing sanctioned tankers across oceans, and quietly buying more intelligence horsepower for SOCOM, all signs that the next phase of competition will be fought with allies who carry more weight, ships that have nowhere left to hide, and analysts working the night shift. #NATO #SOCOM #IndianOcean #USNavy #SOFREP #MSN

item.title: The Boy Who Died Twice …The Inauguration of a Monster
item.description: Violence didn’t excuse the man he became, but if you trace the line from the boots on the porch to the needle in his arm, you can see how a boy dies long before the state ever calls it justice. #Fiction #TeganBroadwater #SOFREP #ExpertStorytelling #MSN #LessonsLearned #CycleOfViolence

item.title: What Gear Did Special Forces Recon Men Carry on the Battlefield?
item.description: Ammo was life in Prairie Fire, because when the NVA hit hard and the sky went quiet for hours, the only thing standing between ST Idaho and getting overrun was what we could carry, shoot, and keep running in the dark. #VietnamWar #MACVSOG #SOGRecon #CAR15 #M79

item.title: SOFREP Cartoon: Great Power Promises Meet Reality
item.description: When the promises run out and the bill comes due, every great power suddenly remembers its first priority is getting its own people out the door. #SOFREP #editorialcartoon #BobLang #MSN #Satire

item.title: Evening Brief: USS Ford Ordered to Middle East, NATO Launches Arctic Exercise, Greek Soldier Arrested for Espionage
item.description: Two carriers surge toward Iran as NATO locks down the Arctic and a Greek colonel’s alleged leak to China reminds everyone that in 2026 the battlefield runs from carrier decks to polar ice to the inside of your own alliance. #EveningBrief #SOFREP #MSN #NATO #USSGeraldRFord #Iran #WorldEvents

item.title: Accountability Without Collapse: What Professional Enforcement Actually Requires
item.description: Public trust survives only when the law is enforced with discipline and restraint, because without professional standards and civic responsibility on both sides of the badge, accountability collapses into noise and the next failure becomes inevitable. #RuleOfLaw #ProfessionalStandards #Accountability #PublicTrust #CivicResponsibility
